turns.speaker: assistant

turns.speaker: assistant

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh nice, those boulder problems can really wear you out! Did you get any time to play your guitar too, or was it a purely active weekend?

turns.text: I actually played a bit last night. Just noodling around with some acoustic songs in the living room while Sam was out.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a peaceful way to wind down a Sunday evening. I hope those client calls go smoothly for you today!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I appreciate it. I'm going to get back to it. Catch you later!
